summary: 16-year-old on a guided canyoneering trip at Amphitheater Bridge in Baby Bathtubs canyon tangled in a rope over a waterfall; cut free, he zip-lined ~50 ft down a guide line and struck his head on rock. Litter raise, CareFlight transfer.
notes: Patient treated for hypothermia risk; flown from Fellin Park after boom-truck litter raise off the team's primary vehicle.
